item.title: Iran aims to ban U.S. and Israeli ships from Strait of Hormuz and charge others a toll
item.description: Iran's parliament is reviewing a plan to ban ships linked to the U.S., Israel and other "hostile countries" from transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The Trump administration has rejected the plan.

item.title: Sticky or slippery? Snails can change their slime to meet the moment
item.description: Snails are slimy. But there's more to that goo of theirs than meets the eye. It's a fact that may help inspire the creation of new materials.

item.title: The park service says Trump's arch would obstruct historic sites. Could it be moved?
item.description: President Trump's proposed arch in Memorial Circle would intrude on dozens of nearby sites, says the National Park Service. But there's been minimal discussion of alternate locations.

item.title: Greetings from a wildlife park in central Sri Lanka that's a haven for elephants
item.description: At a time of increased conflict between elephants and humans, as elephant habitats are converted to intensive agriculture, the Hurulu Eco Park is a place where the animals can graze unimpeded.

item.title: Trump administration moves to deregulate Head Start, opening door for sweeping change
item.description: It would slim regulation of the 60-year-old anti-poverty program and aim to save money. Advocates worry the changes could undermine the early education program's mission.

item.title: This country is the latest to hit the elusive 95/95/95 HIV target
item.description: The United Nations has set a goal for near universal HIV diagnosis and treatment for all by 2030. No country in Asia has hit the mark — until this year.

item.title: El-Sayed wins Michigan's primary. And, Fauci faces contempt of Congress vote
